hotels.title: Safari-Style All-Inclusive Glamping on Ningaloo Reef with Free-Flow Drinks & Wilderness Activities
hotels.description: Get off the grid and into a life of barefoot luxury with a secluded, all-inclusive escape to this breathtaking and exclusive property, limited to 32 guests at any one time. Here, a handful of safari-style wilderness tents sit on a stretch of pristine land, only 50 metres from UNESCO World Heritage-listed Ningaloo Reef. Sal Salis has pristine natural surrounds, where schools of fish, reef sharks and coral formations colour the reef and make for a tropical haven. Head out on a snorkelling adventure through the vibrant coral and seek out the graceful movements of a manta ray, sea turtle or perhaps the majestic whale shark. Paddle across crystal-clear waters in a kayak or enter the ancient lands of Cape Range National Park, where hiking trails guide you past limestone formations, bushland and gorges. With no Wi-Fi, phone reception or television available, time stands still. Spend your evening gazing at bright stars in a sky free of the pollution of civilised light. All the while, take in rich wildlife and unique landscapes while relaxing in the complete comfort of your well-appointed private tent.
